linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo or equivalent
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics or equivalent with Mesa 20+
  • Storage: 520 MB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: N/A
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 24.04
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (8th gen) or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce MX110 or equivalent (Mesa/NVIDIA 470+)
  • Storage: 520 MB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: N/A
